001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003/**
004 * Represents a Caravel ship in the Battleship game.
005 * <p>
006 * A Caravel has a fixed size of two positions and can be oriented
007 * vertically or horizontally according to the specified {@link Compass}
008 * bearing.
009 * </p>
010 *
011 * <p>
012 * The positions occupied by the ship are calculated from the initial
013 * position supplied to the constructor.
014 * </p>
015 *
016 * @author
017 * @version 1.0
018 */
019public class Caravel extends Ship {
020
021    /**
022     * The fixed number of positions occupied by a Caravel.
023     */
024    private static final Integer SIZE = 2;
025
026    /**
027     * The name used to identify a Caravel.
028     */
029    private static final String NAME = "Caravela";
030
031    /**
032     * Creates a new Caravel with the specified bearing and initial position.
033     * <p>
034     * The Caravel occupies two consecutive positions starting from
035     * {@code pos}. If the bearing is {@link Compass#NORTH} or
036     * {@link Compass#SOUTH}, the ship is positioned vertically.
037     * If the bearing is {@link Compass#EAST} or {@link Compass#WEST},
038     * the ship is positioned horizontally.
039     * </p>
040     *
041     * @param bearing the direction in which the Caravel is oriented
042     * @param pos     the initial position used to place the Caravel
043     *
044     * @throws NullPointerException
045     *         if {@code bearing} is {@code null}
046     * @throws IllegalArgumentException
047     *         if {@code bearing} is not a valid direction for positioning
048     *         the Caravel
049     */
050    public Caravel(Compass bearing, IPosition pos)
051            throws NullPointerException, IllegalArgumentException {
052
053        super(Caravel.NAME, bearing, pos);
054
055        if (bearing == null)
056            throw new NullPointerException(
057                    "ERROR! invalid bearing for the caravel"
058            );
059
060        switch (bearing) {
061
062            case NORTH:
063            case SOUTH:
064                for (int r = 0; r < SIZE; r++)
065                    getPositions().add(
066                            new Position(
067                                    pos.getRow() + r,
068                                    pos.getColumn()
069                            )
070                    );
071                break;
072
073            case EAST:
074            case WEST:
075                for (int c = 0; c < SIZE; c++)
076                    getPositions().add(
077                            new Position(
078                                    pos.getRow(),
079                                    pos.getColumn() + c
080                            )
081                    );
082                break;
083
084            default:
085                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
086                        "ERROR! invalid bearing for the caravel"
087                );
088        }
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Returns the size of the Caravel.
093     * <p>
094     * A Caravel always occupies exactly two positions.
095     * </p>
096     *
097     * @return the number of positions occupied by the Caravel
098     */
099    @Override
100    public Integer getSize() {
101        return SIZE;
102    }
103}
